title.b: We Sing Praises To The Lord, Yahweh

meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞：鄭懋柔 Tiffany M. Cheng／曲：恆恩 Brook Heng-En
meta.note: MV 副歌升至 G key

lines.a: 天屬於祢 地也屬於祢
lines.b: The heavens are Yours, the earth belongs to You
The ones You love are filled with joy
They shall shout and praise Your name
We sing praises to the Lord, Yahweh
With a song and dance, we bring You praise

lines.a: 耶和華 祢喜愛祢的百姓
lines.b: You delight in the praises that we sing
In Your sanctuary
We sing praises to the Lord, Yahweh
With a song and dance, we bring You praise

lines.a: 向祢歡呼的民是有福的
lines.b: You praise Blessed are the ones who shout Your name

lines.a: 因祢的名終日歡喜 讚美祢
lines.b: We rejoice in You every day - Praise Your name

lines.a: 喜樂的歌 為我依靠
lines.b: I will go forth with songs of joy
